name: Direction de l'Aviation Civile (Civil Aviation Authority)
aliases: Direction de l'Aviation Civile de Monaco
notes: Renamed from placeholder mc-caa. Identified from web-search results listing official Monaco government pages titled 'Direction de l'Aviation Civile' / 'Civil Aviation Authority' (gouv.mc directory of government departments, under the Ministry of Public Works, the Environment and Urban Development); the search summary gives it duties of civil aviation legislation, aircraft register, airworthiness, licences and heliport/airspace management. Monaco's government portals (gouv.mc, monservicepublic.gouv.mc) return HTTP 403 to automated requests, so the pages could not be read directly. The DAC appears to be a government department without its own logo; Monaco's only identity is the government's. mc-ansp (not part of this batch) is a separate placeholder; the DAC is described as managing airspace and the heliport.

gaps.reason: gouv.mc and monservicepublic.gouv.mc return HTTP 403 to automated requests; not worked around. No DAC-specific logo could be inspected, and the DAC may use only the Monaco government identity.
